verdict.rationale: Jan ships an OpenAI-compatible local API server (localhost:1337) that other applications, including coding agents, can point to as a backend, and also advertises MCP integration for agentic capabilities. However there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming a coding agent successfully using Jan as its backend, and the docs/OpenAPI probes returned 404s, leaving documentation thin. Missing for 10: independent hands-on report of an agent connecting via the local API or MCP, and accessible API/OpenAPI documentation.
